# Lekya Specs (lekya.in) — Premium Eyewear & 3D AR Try-On

## About Lekya Specs
Lekya Specs (https://lekya.in) is India's luxury optical eyewear platform engineered for style, visual clarity, and precision optics. The platform specializes in hand-crafted Japanese Beta Titanium frames, Mazzucchelli acetate spectacles, prescription eyeglasses, polarized sunglasses, and real-time 3D Virtual AR Try-On.

## Key Capabilities & USPs
- **3D AR Virtual Try-On Studio**: Real-time webcam and 3D facial mesh frame fitting (https://lekya.in/tryon).
- **Express Same-Day Delivery**: 4-hour pan-Delhi NCR delivery (Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad) powered by Parcel Uncle & Lekya Logistics.
- **Precision Prescription Optics**: Single Vision, Bifocal, Progressive, Anti-Glare (ARC), Blue-Light Filter, and Photochromic Transitions.
- **Custom Bespoke Studio**: Custom frame design and lens customization studio.

## Core Product Categories
- **Prescription Eyeglasses**: Hand-polished acetate, titanium wireframes, cat-eye, wayfarer, rectangle, round, and rimless designs.
- **Polarized Sunglasses**: UV400 pilot aviators, clubmasters, vintage wayfarers, and sports wrap sunglasses.

## Sister Entities & Group Companies
- **Lekya Group**: Parent conglomerate.
- **Lekya Logistics**: Pan-India logistics & supply chain partner (https://lekyalogistics.com).
- **ParcelUncle**: Pan-India carrier aggregator & hyper-local delivery engine (https://parceluncle.com).
- **Lekya Energy**: Renewable solar energy division.
